messages:
Ivy: Quick runbook request from Oakfield Bank POC. They want a short evidence blurb: exactly which regions processing may occur, who (subprocessors) can see request metadata, KMS BYOK flow, log retention & export options, and confirmation on whether model artifacts ever leave a customer region for Dedicated or Hosted. Need to send by EOD.

Ravi: Short bullets I can paste: Hosted API: per-region serving (us-east-1/us-west-2 for NA; eu-west-1 for EU). Model weights are cached in-region at runtime. During onboarding we pull artifacts into the target region; we do not execute inference across regions. Dedicated/Private: can be deployed into customer VPC; artifacts may remain only in-customer storage.

Ravi: KMS: default = Redwood-managed AWS KMS. Option = customer-managed AWS KMS (BYOK) with cross-account key-encrypt/decrypt role. Private deployments can support customer HSM. BYOK flow: customer provides key ARN -> we use key for envelope encryption; key material never leaves customer account.

Ivy: Subprocessor snapshot for email: compute/storage = AWS (EC2/EKS/S3), telemetry = Datadog, errors = Sentry, notifications = SES, analytics = Segment. Provide CSV from Legal for signed list.

LegalBot: automated: We can produce a date-stamped, Legal-stamped subprocessor CSV and DPA excerpt. Requestor must supply contact for delivery. For contractual subprocessor SLAs, escalate to Legal.

Ravi: Logs/audit: default retention 90 days (encrypted at rest). For Dedicated/Private we can forward audit logs to customer-owned S3 or CloudWatch (cross-account). Exports: full audit export available on request for Dedicated/Private. Diagnostic traces may contain truncated request metadata; full request bodies are not exported by default.

Ivy: Bank also asked if debug mode could cause request bodies to be stored. Answer?

Sam: Clarify: debug mode can persist request bodies to internal storage for a short troubleshooting window but only with explicit customer opt-in and retention is limited. Default behavior: no persistent storage of request bodies.

ops-bot: automated: Ops checklist to attach if they want Dedicated POC: provide VPC/subnet IDs and CIDR, cross-account KMS role ARN, customer log bucket + IAM policy, time window for initial artifact transfer (1-3 hours), expected traffic profile.

Ivy: Linking current CSV for Legal stamp: https://internal.redwood/storage/subprocessors/2026-03-24-current.csv

LegalBot: automated: Subprocessor CSV uploaded v2026-03-24. Hash: sha256:feedfacecafebabe... :white_check_mark:

Ivy: Great, thanks. I'll assemble a one-page evidence blurb and send to Oakfield Bank. Ping if Legal needs anything else for stamping. :thumbsup:
